★ TF-C87 (D-PP-INCLUDE-REENTRY-GUARD-AWARE) — guard-aware include RE-ENTRY, runtime witness. The preprocessor used to REFUSE re-entry into any header already on the include stack (`P0016 circular include of X`), which rejects legal, standard-conforming C: real cpp has no refuse-re-entry rule, only a nesting DEPTH limit, and the include GUARD is what terminates the cycle. MEASURED on the macho corpus leg at 5093341, `src/mem1.c`: `mach/mach_types.h -> mach/task_policy.h -> mach/mach_types.h` produced 4 F001A + 1 P0016, the leg's ENTIRE residual F001A count (macho 54 -> 49 errors after this cycle; pe 13 and elf 8 unchanged).
WHAT IS WITNESSED: this program DID NOT COMPILE before. A refused include is a hard error, not a miscompile, so there is no wrong-answer arm — the witness is that the artifact builds with zero diagnostics and RUNS to 42 over an include graph with THREE genuine back edges (b.h->a.h, d.h->a.h, d.h->b.h), each into a header on the stack at that moment.
★ FOUR HEADERS, FOUR GUARD FORMS, ONE ADDEND EACH. Guard DETECTION now GATES re-entry, so an unrecognised but LEGAL guard becomes a refused include — a compiler bug from the user's side. The sqlite corpus exercises only `#ifndef`, so every other spelling would otherwise ship with no runtime coverage. Each form below was MEASURED in the real macOS 26 SDK (3100 headers) and/or the sqlite tree (52 headers) by scripts/guard-shape-census: FORM 1 `#ifndef X`/`#define X` (2942 SDK, 35 sqlite — the mach_types.h shape); FORM 2 `#if !defined(X)` (10 SDK, 1 sqlite); FORM 3 a COMPOUND condition of MIXED polarity, taken verbatim in shape from sqlite's own `ext/misc/windirent.h` (`#if defined(_WIN32) && defined(_MSC_VER) && !defined(SQLITE_WINDIRENT_H)`) and `ext/session/sqlite3session.h`; FORM 4 the guard is NOT the first conditional AND its `#define` is not adjacent (`netinet6/in6.h` opens with an umbrella check; libc++ `inttypes.h`/`stdint.h` put the define 5 lines down — 11 + 15 SDK headers). A detector gap on ANY ONE form takes the whole program down rather than hiding behind the others. 10+11+9+12 = 42, with each addend also checked individually so a compensating pair cannot reach 42 by accident, plus a real function DEFINITION in the deepest header whose duplicate would fail the build if the guard did not empty a re-entered copy.
★ CLANG GROUND TRUTH, not DSS's opinion: clean under `/usr/bin/clang -std=c11 -Wall -Wextra -fsyntax-only` and the clang-built binary independently exits 42. The `release` arm runs the shipped parser->semantic->codegen->native pipeline over the same source, so it also witnesses that the optimizer does not disturb the spliced result.
